services.name: Fishing Pack
services.desc: Getting ready for a fly fishing trip should feel exciting-not overwhelming. When you book with North Fork Ranch Guide Service, you don’t need to stress about gear. As a fully equipped Orvis-Endorsed Outfitter, we provide everything you need for a great day on the water, including waders, boots (with women’s and youth sizes), rods, reels, and all terminal tackle. Prefer to bring your own gear? Use the list below as a guide to make sure you’re covered. And if you’re missing something, we’ve got high-quality Orvis gear ready to go. blurb: North Fork Ranch Guide Service offers guided fly fishing trips on private and public waters near Denver, Colorado. They provide expert guides and exclusive access to productive trout fisheries. Guests can stay in rustic log cabins at the North Fork Ranch lodge.

quotes.author: John Lammers
quotes.text: I just came back from my third visit to the North Fork Ranch in three years. Each visit has been reliably top-notch with wonderful service, accommodations, and great food. And the guide service is just unmatchable. Our guide, Shannah, fit perfectly with our skill levels, and eagerly equipped us to have a great time. I can't recommend North Fork highly enough.

quotes.author: J Roubaud
quotes.text: Highly recommend North Fork Ranch! I fly fished for the first time with them as part of a company outing. Our guides Tim and Rob were so friendly, knowledgeable, and patient. All 5 of us on the outing caught over a dozen fish each. We all had a great time, and we left as better anglers thanks to everything Tim and Rob taught us.

quotes.author: David Gonzales
quotes.text: Traveled from Austin, TX for my first experience with the North Fork Ranch Guide Service. We did a family trip and could not have been more pleased! The guides were exceptional, the location was beautiful, and the fishing was great! Would highly recommend to anyone seeking a great Colorado fishing experience.

quotes.author: Bob Leiter
quotes.text: What a place! The fishing is phenomenal and such a beautiful setting. I have been there twice now and had different guides each time and both were top notch! Jeff and his team of guides are some of the best and you WILL catch fish! Highly recommend! A+++
